info.name: arTaH
info.note: aBiBavaH ityasya dvO arTO staH - tiraskAraH (= nyUnIBavanam), taTA ca parABavaH (nyUnIkaraRam) iti . 'tiraskAraH' asmin arTe ayaM DAtuH akarmakarUpeRa prayujyate . yaTA - devadattaH aDyayanAt parAjayate (devadattaH aDyayanasya tiraskAraM karoti ityarTaH) . 'parABavaH' asmin arTe tu ayaM sakarmakarUpeRa prayujyate . yaTA - devadattaH yajYadattaM jayati (devadattaH yajYadattasya parABavaM karoti ityarTaH)

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to win, to conquer, to dislike, to refrain

info.name: DAturUpanandinIwippaRI
info.value: aBiBavo nyUnIkaraRaM nyUnIBavanaM ca . Adye sakarmakaH, dvitIye tu akarmakaH .
